agent.problem: Nothing in the opening card lets the baker reason out the ten years; choosing among ten, forty and seven is luck. As a fill-in-the-blank card, it asks for wording the baker has not seen rather than a meaning they can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: Eight of the twelve choice cards are multiple choice, while only two are true or false and two are fill in the blank. Multiple choice therefore dominates the stop by a wide margin.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.
